final: WITH account_group AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount ELSE NULL END) AS group_average FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), frequency_group AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(group_average) AS frequency_average FROM account_group GROUP BY frequency) SELECT ag.account_id, ag.frequency, ag.group_average, ag.group_average / fg.frequency_average AS quotient FROM account_group AS ag JOIN frequency_group AS fg ON ag.frequency = fg.frequency ORDER BY quotient DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
